exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.beginnerSummary: Push-ups build chest, shoulder, triceps, and core strength. Beginners can use wall push-ups or knee push-ups first.
exercises.imageCaption: Keep a straight line from shoulders through hips and brace the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank or elevated wall position.
Place hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower with control, then press away from the floor or wall.
tips: Use wall push-ups if floor reps are too hard.
Keep elbows roughly 45 degrees from your body.
Stop if wrists or shoulders feel sharp pain.
exercises.youtubeQuery: beginner push up proper form tutorial

exercises.name: Sit-ups
exercises.beginnerSummary: Sit-ups train the front of the core. If your lower back feels uncomfortable, use dead bugs or crunches instead.
exercises.imageCaption: Move slowly and avoid yanking on your neck.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl up under control, then lower slowly.
tips: Switch to dead bugs if your back feels strained.
exercises.youtubeQuery: beginner sit up proper form tutorial

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.beginnerSummary: Squats train the legs and hips. Chair squats are the safest beginner version because they teach depth and balance.
exercises.imageCaption: Sit hips back toward a chair while keeping your chest tall.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Push hips back like sitting into a chair.
Stand tall by pressing through the whole foot.
tips: Use a chair or counter for support.
Stop before knee or hip pain.
exercises.youtubeQuery: beginner chair squat proper form tutorial

exercises.name: Running
exercises.beginnerSummary: Running can be scaled to walking intervals. Keep the pace conversational and build distance slowly.
exercises.imageCaption: Use short relaxed steps and keep breathing steady.
instructions: Warm up with five minutes of walking.
Alternate easy jogging and walking if needed.
Finish with a slow walk to recover.
tips: Start with walking if running is too intense.
Do not chase speed on beginner days.
exercises.youtubeQuery: beginner running form tutorial walk jog intervals
